name: relay
description: Relay — record, automate, and inspect mobile app tests on real devices

scripts.doctor: pnpm --filter @relay/cli exec tsx src/index.ts system doctor
scripts.test: pnpm run ios-preview:test && pnpm run test:packages && vp test
scripts.test:ios-terminality: pnpm --filter @relay/core exec tsx --test src/ios-mutation-terminality-contract.test.ts src/workspace-capture-video.test.ts && pnpm --filter @relay/server exec tsx --import ./scripts/test-environment.mjs --test src/step-run-route.test.ts src/corpus-routes.test.ts && pnpm --filter @relay/app exec tsx --test src/lib/ios-interaction-safety.test.ts && pnpm --filter @relay/mcp exec tsx --test src/server.test.ts
scripts.verify: vp check && pnpm run check:docs && pnpm run check:architecture && pnpm run test:architecture && pnpm typecheck && pnpm run ios-preview:test && pnpm run test:packages && vp test && pnpm --filter @relay/app check:ui && pnpm --filter @relay/app build && pnpm --filter @relay/desktop build && pnpm run ios-preview:verify
